macro_policy.target_work_size: approximately 25-40 minutes equivalent meaningful work; calibrated around about four former small tasks
macro_policy.integration_policy: HQ integrates only at lane checkpoint or explicit blocker rescue; workers do not wait for other lanes during normal execution
macro_policy.shared_contract_policy: At epoch start each lane syncs once to the latest integration Shared/App contracts, records that base SHA, then works independently until checkpoint. Shared/App changes remain HQ-only.

macro_backlog.goal: Finish the rights-aware real-audio separation evaluation system as an executable package, not only a skeleton.
subtasks: complete G1/G2 rights manifest ingestion and fail-closed validation
complete objective reference-stem metric runner plus blind-listening capture format
add negative/edge tests for missing rights, fake/synthetic-only fixtures, incomplete stems and expired outputs
write reproducible operator instructions and evidence examples clearly marked NON-PARITY
macro_backlog.done_when: evaluation package, tests and validation evidence are committed; no real quality claim is made without real rights-cleared fixtures

macro_backlog.goal: Harden processing lifecycle around provider ambiguity, cancellation, reconnect and idempotency without changing Shared contracts.
subtasks: add provider-capability adapter for stable idempotency when a provider supports it internally
add crash/relaunch and partial-result transaction tests
document exact remaining Shared-contract request only if unavoidable
macro_backlog.done_when: lifecycle failure matrix is executable and all supported recovery paths have tests/evidence

macro_backlog.goal: Build production separation output validation and retention/cost accounting around the existing server/provider seam.
subtasks: implement project-controlled copy verification before vendor URL expiry
record retention/delete lifecycle and cost inputs
produce machine-readable run manifest ready for future live AudioShake or project-owned model evidence
macro_backlog.done_when: output validator/accounting layer and tests are committed and can consume a live provider later without redesign

macro_backlog.goal: Prepare the full real-separator differential runbook and batch executor for immediate use when credentials and G1/G2 fixtures arrive.
subtasks: capture wall time/retry/failure/cost and artifact paths
generate Moises-vs-project comparison input manifest without copying Moises assets
produce reviewer worksheet and acceptance calculation
fail closed when required real fixtures or legal grants are absent
macro_backlog.done_when: one command/runbook can execute the complete future real-audio separation gate once external inputs are supplied

macro_backlog.goal: Implement the complete Core Data persistence adapter behind frozen HQ Library contracts.
subtasks: persist user edits and processing recovery snapshot
store only stable IDs/scalars/relative file paths
add in-memory or isolated-store contract tests
macro_backlog.done_when: ProjectLibraryPersisting behavior is implemented across the full current contract surface with tests

macro_backlog.goal: Implement destructive-operation and crash-safety semantics for Library persistence.
subtasks: idempotent artifact cleanup and orphan sweep
tests proving metadata never points to incomplete files after simulated interruption
macro_backlog.done_when: delete/recovery lifecycle is executable, repeatable and covered by interruption tests

macro_backlog.goal: Implement migration/corruption recovery and explicit user-data preservation behavior.
subtasks: validation document with destructive reset explicitly forbidden
macro_backlog.done_when: migration/corruption scenarios have tests and no silent user-data deletion path exists

macro_backlog.goal: Complete IO/Library integration inside Lane 2 without depending on the iOS shell.
subtasks: durable imported-file ownership handoff into Library metadata
end-to-end lane-local import->persist->edit->export metadata test using owned seams
macro_backlog.done_when: Lane 2 can prove its own durable lifecycle independently; actual iPhone picker/share UI remains late-integration evidence

macro_backlog.goal: Complete the device-measurement harness for Playback and DSP, including thresholds and evidence format.
subtasks: tempo/pitch artifact and render latency capture
machine-readable result schema plus fixture manifest and pass/fail threshold documentation
macro_backlog.done_when: harness can be compiled/wired later by HQ without editing Lane 3 core and harness-only evidence cannot falsely pass PARITY

macro_backlog.goal: Harden multitrack transport semantics and long-track behavior independent of an iOS host target.
subtasks: sample-frame seek/loop normalization at long durations
stem offset and duration mismatch handling
stress/property tests for drift and overflow
macro_backlog.done_when: portable transport semantics pass deterministic stress tests with no accumulated timing drift

macro_backlog.goal: Harden gain, solo/mute and practice DSP control behavior for click/pop risk and invalid state handling.
subtasks: tempo/pitch range validation and state restoration
failure-safe behavior when Apple backend is unavailable
macro_backlog.done_when: control semantics and safety tests are complete; audible quality remains explicitly pending device evidence

macro_backlog.goal: Build an offline/reference render path inside Playback/DSP for later differential measurement.
subtasks: deterministic render plan for stems plus practice settings
capture expected timeline events and render metadata
document exact Apple-runtime checks deferred to HQ integration
macro_backlog.done_when: Lane 3 can generate deterministic reference evidence independently of the final app shell

macro_backlog.goal: Create the standalone canonical iOS host/build target around frozen Shared/App contracts without waiting for other lanes.
subtasks: define injection/module slots for IO/Library/Playback/DSP/Separation without copying those implementations
add simulator build instructions and platform smoke target
macro_backlog.done_when: the iOS host exists and builds in an Apple/Xcode-capable environment when available; cross-lane compilation is explicitly deferred to HQ late integration

macro_backlog.goal: Implement BPM/beat and musical-key analysis behind frozen HQ analysis contracts.
macro_backlog.done_when: BPM/beat/key outputs are implemented with benchmarkable evidence and no synthetic-only PARITY claim

macro_backlog.goal: Implement chord timeline analysis and playback-clock-friendly output.
macro_backlog.done_when: chord timeline output is deterministic, benchmarkable and conforms to frozen contracts

macro_backlog.goal: Implement song-section analysis and complete the Analysis evidence pack.
subtasks: late-integration handoff document for App/Playback consumption
macro_backlog.done_when: Lane 4 analysis surface is complete enough for HQ integration without further Worker-to-Worker dependency

late_integration_gate.starts_after: lane checkpoint; not after every bundle
responsibilities: compile actual integrated iOS target with all lane implementations
run real-device and differential Moises evidence
create next four independent lane backlogs before workers resume
